issues.title: Support Panel has to share horizontal space with leaflet map
issues.body:
Currently the `SupportPanel` sits above the map.

When we select an asset, leaflet `flies` us to the asset, putting in the centre of the screen.

But, when the support panel is extended past 1/2 way over the map, this puts the selected asset _underneath_ the support panel - and it can't be seen.

There may be a number of solutions to this, but I'd like us to start off by experimenting with sitting the Support Panel and that map in the same space. So, as the user expands the support panel - the map collapses.  In this way - all of the map is visible, and when a player selects and asset - the selected asset will still be positioned in the centre of the visible map.
